title: Jordi Visser: Bitcoin as AI-Proof Store of Value

excerpts.label: Bitcoin is digital store of value, not digital gold
excerpts.insight: BTC competes with all fiat stores ($500-800T), not just gold. Demographic rotation: older holders don't believe, younger ones do.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Size BTC position against total fiat store of value TAM, not gold market cap. Generational wealth transfer = structural bid.

excerpts.label: Bitcoin is belief-based, AI disrupts everything else
excerpts.insight: BTC already won digital store of value battle. AI will disrupt all businesses including real estate—Bitcoin's moat is belief, not innovation.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BTC = hedge against AI disruption of all other asset classes. No innovation risk, only adoption risk.

excerpts.label: Fear and need drive institutional adoption speed
excerpts.insight: OGs selling because wealthy, no longer need it. El Salvador-type buyers have need. Silent IPO: churning from OGs to new holders.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Monitor on-chain OG wallet flows. Institutional adoption driven by career risk asymmetry—wait for 'need' catalyst.

excerpts.label: Mag 7 spending billions competing on free commodity
excerpts.insight: Hyperscalers competing with each other, spending enormous capex. If OpenAI fails, all multiples compress. No one's proven AI monetization yet.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Short Mag 7 vs SPX as AI capex destroys margins. Watch OpenAI solvency as canary for multiple compression.

excerpts.label: Silent IPO distribution phase is over
excerpts.insight: Distribution over since October. OGs continue selling but buying power exceeds it. Three buyer types: EM entrepreneurs, institutions, retail traders.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Technical setup bullish: supply overhang absorbed. Add on 3 daily closes >92K as retail re-engagement signal.

excerpts.label: Tokenization unlocks balance sheet rotation to Bitcoin
excerpts.insight: Tokenization enables real estate/PE liquidity. $178T household net worth can finally exit illiquid assets into crypto rails.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Tokenization = structural flow unlock. Watch real estate tokenization adoption as leading indicator for BTC inflows.

excerpts.label: MSTR is not leverage—it's digital capital structure bet
excerpts.insight: Owns MSTR for 5% Bitcoin ownership in future digital capital structure, not leverage. No other company can catch up to that position.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: MSTR = call option on BTC becoming reserve asset. Position for NAV re-rating, not BTC beta.

excerpts.label: Fiscal dominance permanent—GDP growing, no jobs
excerpts.insight: Nominal GDP 5%, real GDP 3%+, yet no job creation. Innovation + AI worsens wealth distribution. Fiscal dominance can't end until abundance.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Fed irrelevant—fiscal dominance = perpetual money printing. Long hard assets, short duration.
